description: This Java source file defines the class 'TopicParseException', a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto framework, particularly for handling errors related to parsing topics from string representations. It includes builder pattern implementations for creating exception instances and various static methods for constructing exceptions from messages or JSON objects.
